arxiv-2311-02864.title: Runs of extremes of observables on dynamical systems and applications. Thanks: MN thanks the NSF for support from NSF-DMS 2009923.
arxiv-2311-02864.creator: Meagan Carney, Mark Holland, Matthew Nicol, Phuong Tran
arxiv-2311-02864.description: Abstract . We use extreme value theory to estimate the probability of successive exceedances of a threshold value of a time-series of an observable on several classes of chaotic dynamical systems. The observables have either a Fréchet (fat-tailed) or Weibull (bounded) distribution.

arxiv-2402-11166.title: GenDec: A robust generative Question-decomposition method for Multi-hop reasoning
arxiv-2402-11166.creator: Jian Wu, Linyi Yang, Yuliang Ji, Wenhao Huang, Börje F. Karlsson, Manabu Okumura
arxiv-2402-11166.description: Abstract Multi-hop QA (MHQA) involves step-by-step reasoning to answer complex questions and find multiple relevant supporting facts. However, Existing large language models’(LLMs) reasoning ability in multi-hop question answering remains exploration, which is inadequate in answering multi-hop questions. Moreover, it is unclear whether LLMs follow a desired reasoning chain to reach the right final answer.

arxiv-2406-14712.title: Qiskit HumanEval: An Evaluation Benchmark For Quantum Code Generative Models
arxiv-2406-14712.creator: Sanjay Vishwakarma 3 , Francis Harkins 3 , Siddharth Golecha 4 , Vishal Sharathchandra Bajpe 3 , Nicolas Dupuis 1 , Luca Buratti 2 , David Kremer 3 , Ismael Faro 3 , Ruchir Puri 1 and Juan Cruz-Benito 3
arxiv-2406-14712.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sanjay Vishwakarma 3 , Francis Harkins 3 , Siddharth Golecha 4 , Vishal Sharathchandra Bajpe 3 , Nicolas Dupuis 1 , Luca Buratti 2 , David Kremer 3 , Ismael Faro 3 , Ruchir Puri 1 and Juan Cruz-Benito 3. Quantum programs are typically developed using quantum Software Development Kits (SDKs). The rapid advancement of quantum computing necessitates new tools to streamline this development process, and one such tool could be Generative Artificial intelligence (GenAI).

arxiv-2408-09024.title: Investigating the mixing between two black hole populations in LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA GWTC-3
arxiv-2408-09024.creator: Ming-Feng Ho 1, Scott E. Perkins 2, Simeon Bird 1, William A. Dawson 2, Nathan Golovich 2, Jessica R. Lu 3, Peter McGill 2
arxiv-2408-09024.description: Abstract We introduce a population model to analyze the mixing between hypothesised power-law and ∼ 35 ​ M ⊙ \sim 35M_{\odot} Gaussian bump black hole populations in the latest gravitational wave catalog, GWTC-3, estimating their co-location and separation. We find a relatively low level of mixing, 3.1 − 3.1 + 5.0 % 3.1^{+5.0}_{-3.

arxiv-2412-09616.title: V2PE: Improving Multimodal Long-Context Capability of Vision-Language Models with Variable Visual Position Encoding
arxiv-2412-09616.creator: Junqi Ge, Ziyi Chen, Jintao Lin, Jinguo Zhu, Xihui Liu, Jifeng Dai, Xizhou Zhu
arxiv-2412-09616.description: Abstract Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown promising capabilities in handling various multimodal tasks, yet they struggle in long-context scenarios, particularly in tasks involving videos, high-resolution images, or lengthy image-text documents. In our work, we first conduct an empirical analysis of the long-context capabilities of VLMs using our augmented long-context multimodal datasets.

arxiv-2412-12568.title: Two-dimensional imaging of electromagnetic fields via light sheet fluorescence imaging with Rydberg atoms
arxiv-2412-12568.creator: Noah Schlossberger, Tate McDonald, Kevin Su, Rajavardhan Talashila, Robert Behary, Charles L. Patrick, Daniel Hammerland, Eugeniy E. Mikhailov, Seth Aubin, Irina Novikova, Christopher L. Holloway, Nikunjkumar Prajapati
arxiv-2412-12568.description: Abstract The ability to image electromagnetic fields holds key scientific and industrial applications, including electromagnetic compatibility, diagnostics of high-frequency devices, and experimental scientific work involving field interactions. Generally electric and magnetic field measurements require conductive elements which significantly distort the field.

arxiv-2503-11041.title: Enhancing Adaptivity of Two-Fingered Object Reorientation Using Tactile-based Online Optimization of Deconstructed Actions
arxiv-2503-11041.creator: Qiyin Huang, Tiemin Li, Yao Jiang
arxiv-2503-11041.description: Abstract Object reorientation is a critical task for robotic grippers, especially when manipulating objects within constrained environments. The task poses significant challenges for motion planning due to the high-dimensional output actions with the complex input information, including unknown object properties and nonlinear contact forces.

arxiv-2509-12666.title: PBPK-iPINNs: Inverse Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Physiologically Based Pharmacokinetic Brain Models
arxiv-2509-12666.creator: Charuka D. Wickramasinghe † , Krishanthi C. Weerasinghe ‡ , and Pradeep K. Ranaweera ‡
arxiv-2509-12666.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Charuka D. Wickramasinghe † , Krishanthi C. Weerasinghe ‡ , and Pradeep K. Ranaweera ‡. Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) leverage machine learning with differential equations to solve direct and inverse problems, ensuring predictions follow physical laws. Physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) modeling advances beyond classical compartmental approaches by using a mechanistic, physiology focused framework. A PBPK model is based on a system of ODEs, with each equation representing the mass balance of a drug in a compartment, such as an organ or tissue.

pmc-10511493.description: tise are available.•Both arms up are considered more stable; one arm up may be considered for patients that cannot tolerate both arms up.•When using supine positioning, both flat and elevated board positions are acceptable provided collision risks are managed and the patient is appropriately stabilised.Immobilisation•There is insufficient evidence to support the adoption of any specific immobilisation device of the breast.

pmc-10557873.title: Improved long‐term outcomes after innovative preoperative evaluation and conception of precise surgery for gallbladder cancer
pmc-10557873.creator: Zi‐Yao Jia, Yi‐Di Zhu, Xiang‐Song Wu, Jing‐Xiao Yang, Wen‐Guang Wu, Xu‐An Wang, Min He, Hui Wang, Lin‐Hua Yang, Jie Zhang, Xue‐Chuan Li, Lu Zou, Huai‐Feng Li, Fei Zhang, Run‐Fa Bao, Xu‐Ya Cui, Xiao‐Ling Song, Wei Chen, Wei Gong, Mao‐Lan Li, Ying‐Bin Liu
pmc-10557873.description: BackgroundThree‐dimensional visualization preoperative evaluation (3D‐VPE) and enhanced recovery after surgery (ERAS) have been suggested to improve outcomes of cancer surgery in patients, yet little is known regarding their clinical benefit in patients with gallbladder cancer (GBC). We hypothesized that the combination of 3D‐VPE and ERAS would improve the outcome of patients undergoing surgery for GBC.

pmc-11477958.title: Outpatient Management Protocol for Uncomplicated Diverticulitis: A 3-Year Monocentric Experience in a Tertiary Hospital
pmc-11477958.creator: Marie Burgard, Alexis Litchinko, Jeremy Meyer, Christian Toso, Frédéric Ris, Vaihere Delaune, Andreas Neff, Jun Kato
pmc-11477958.description: Background/Objectives: The management of acute uncomplicated diverticulitis (AUD) has shifted towards outpatient care in the last decade, challenging the traditional inpatient approach. We aimed to analyze the safety and feasibility of a structured outpatient treatment pathway for AUD in a tertiary hospital.

pmc-11679789.title: Gene Silencing via Ingestion of Double-Stranded RNA in Wireworm of Agriotes Species
pmc-11679789.creator: Jyoti Joshi, Robert Coffin, Ryan Barrett, Gefu Wang-Pruski, Honglin Feng
pmc-11679789.description: Simple SummaryWireworms, the larvae of click beetles (Agriotes species), are notorious insect pests that damage crops worldwide and cause huge economic losses. Several studies have attempted to identify alternate management strategies, including the use of pesticides. As a biotechnological alternative, RNA interference (RNAi) has been used to control insect pests.

pmc-11727288.title: Psychiatric Disorders and Cognitive Fluctuations in Parkinson’s Disease: Changing Approaches in the First Decades of the 21st Century
pmc-11727288.creator: Marco Onofrj, Matteo Alessandro De Rosa, Mirella Russo, Paola Ajdinaj, Dario Calisi, Astrid Thomas, Stefano Luca Sensi
pmc-11727288.description: Parkinson’s Disease (PD) is a multifaceted neurodegenerative disorder characterized, in addition to the well-recognized motor disturbances, by a complex interplay between cognitive and psychiatric manifestations. We dissect the complex landscape of PD-related psychiatric symptoms, taking into account the impact of functional neurological disorders, somatic delusions, impulse control disorders, and conditions within the bipolar spectrum.

pmc-12579637.title: Clinical value of multimodal ultrasound in evaluating intestinal stiffness and fibrosis in active Crohn’s disease
pmc-12579637.creator: Xielu Sun, Chengfang Wang, Dingyuan Hu, Guolong Ma, Zhihua Xu
pmc-12579637.description: ObjectiveIt was hypothesized that virtual touch tissue imaging and quantification (VTIQ) is more accurate in quantifying intestinal stiffness compared to conventional B-mode ultrasound for detecting Crohn’s disease (CD) stenosis. We aimed to explore the diagnostic value of multimodal ultrasound in intestinal stenosis of CD.Materials and methodsA retrospective analysis of CD patients (May 2020 to October 2024) was conducted.

pmc-12594805.title: Insights from integrated covalent docking and molecular dynamics simulations of nirmatrelvir analogs as potential SARS-CoV-2 Mpro inhibitors
pmc-12594805.creator: Mahmoud A. A. Ibrahim, Doaa M. A. Khaled, Doaa G. M. Mahmoud, Alaa H. M. Abdelrahman, Peter A. Sidhom, Yanshuo Han, Tamer Shoeib, Badr Aldahmash, Ahmed Rady
pmc-12594805.description: The COVID-19 epidemic has posed a considerable challenge to the worldwide economy and public health, underscoring the crucial demand for developing effective antiviral medications. The SARS-CoV-2 main protease (Mpro) is a vital enzyme for antiviral drugs because of its fundamental function in viral reproduction.

pmc-13197917.title: Emerging mechanistic trends and clinical efficacy for methotrexate: Applications to inflammatory bowel disease
pmc-13197917.creator: Jeehyun Karen You, Theresa T Pizarro, Tommaso L Parigi
pmc-13197917.description: Methotrexate (MTX) was among the first steroid-sparing agents introduced for the treatment of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). Its efficacy is well established for Crohn’s disease, though studies of its use in ulcerative colitis have largely reported negative results, with only some, although inconsistent, findings suggesting limited benefit.

pmc-13348111.title: Epidemiological analysis of acute poisoning cases based on Poison control center data from 2021 to 2024
pmc-13348111.creator: Qing Tang, Jiaqi Xu, Xin Luo, Hao Wang, Shuxin Hua, Yanfen Chai, Lijun Wang
pmc-13348111.description: BackgroundTo determine the circumstances of acute poisoning cases at the Poison Control Center (2021–2024) and analyze their risk factors.MethodsWe retrospectively analyzed the demographic characteristics, clinical features, and prognosis of patients with acute poisoning at the Poison Control Center.ResultsThis study included 10,402 cases comprising drug poisoning (5,074), alcohol poisoning (2,316), carbon monoxide poisoning (1,803), pesticide poisoning (882), and chemical poisoning (327).

pmc-13383468.title: Exploratory analysis of regional factors influencing early childhood caries status in 5-year-old children: evidence from national oral health surveys of China, 2005–2015
pmc-13383468.creator: Langxin Pan, Yangfan Peng, Xinzhu Zhou, Shuguo Zheng, Jian Liu, Xiangyu Sun
pmc-13383468.description: BackgroundCurrently, regional disparities of early childhood caries (ECC) remained underexplored. This study aimed to investigate the associations of regional factors with temporal variations of ECC among 5-year-old children in China using data from the 3rd National Oral Health Survey of China (the 2005 survey) and the 4th National Oral Health Survey of China (the 2015 survey).
